title: Sleigh My Name: Festive Music Bingo on Friday 11 December
preheader: £5 cash entry, two themed rounds and a 7pm start. Reserve online, pay on the night.

data.heading: Christmas jumpers earn extra points
body: Nikki hosts two fully themed rounds of festive Music Bingo, from the classic Christmas number ones to the cheesy singalongs. Listen to each clip, match it to the titles on your card and mark the square. No expert music knowledge needed.
Reserve online, pay on the night. Entry costs £5 per person, payable in cash when you arrive. No online payment is taken.

image.alt: Sleigh My Name festive Music Bingo at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

rows.label: Seating
rows.value: Communal tables, book your group together

data.heading: A few things to know
body: Expect quick games, spot prizes, a few surprises and plenty of singing along. Whether you know every tune or just fancy a good singalong, you can join in.
Come early for dinner, served from 4pm to 9pm, and settle in before the first round.

data.body: Book everyone in your group together, then dig out the jumper with the lights on it.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
